title: Filtering prompts by pass rate before RL
purpose: Estimate each RL prompt's pass rate with the SFT model (16 answers per prompt, scored by the verifier pool) and keep only prompts between 5% and 95%. The kept prompts become new, write-once dataset versions that the RL recipe names.
